stories.title: Trump's big weekend: The arch, Greenland, and media outlets banned from White House
stories.summary: President Trump's exertion of power over the press, Greenland and even the D.C. landscape are teeing up questions over the president's limits.

stories.title: In conversation with 'the most normal guy in Hollywood' — Weird Al
stories.summary: After decades of making parody music, Weird Al has new generations of fans. His Tiny Desk Concert saw an audience of people in their 60s and kids who could have been their grandchildren.

stories.title: AI and autonomous weapons are high on the agenda at the UN General Assembly
stories.summary: As world leaders gather for the U.N. General Assembly's annual general debate, Colombia's former president and Nobel Peace Prize laureate discusses the growing risks of autonomous weapons and AI

stories.title: Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.

stories.title: 'Washington Post' finds discrepancies in Iran war death numbers
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Tara Copp of The Washington Post about her reporting on the Defense Department's accounting of U.S. troops who've died over the course of the war with Iran.

stories.title: Remembering Chad Gilbert, guitarist of New Found Glory
stories.summary: New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert died recently, after a battle with cancer. NPR remembers the founding member of the punk rock bank.
